crossRefs.note: The waters will fail from the sea, and the river will be wasted and become dry.
He will give the rain for your seed, with which you will sow the ground; and bread of the increase of the ground will…
For as the rain comes down and the snow from the sky, and doesn’t return there, but waters the earth, and makes it grow…
so is my word that goes out of my mouth: it will not return to me void, but it will accomplish that which I please, and…
Cast your bread on the waters; for you shall find it after many days.
Then those who gladly received his word were baptized. There were added that day about three thousand souls.
But many of those who heard the word believed, and the number of the men came to be about five thousand.
More believers were added to the Lord, multitudes of both men and women.
I planted. Apollos watered. But God gave the increase.
Now the fruit of righteousness is sown in peace by those who make peace.

For it is written in the law of Moses, “You shall not muzzle an ox while it treads out the grain.” Is it for the oxen…

translations.web: Blessed are you who sow beside all waters, who send out the feet of the ox and the donkey.
translations.bsb: Blessed are those who sow beside abundant waters, who let the ox and donkey range freely.
translations.kjv: Blessed are ye that sow beside all waters, that send forth thither the feet of the ox and the ass.
translations.asv: Blessed are yet that sow beside all waters, that send forth the feet of the ox and the ass.
